messages:
Ivy: Quick UX check on the encryption/KMS wording in the Region + Retention flow. The dropdown currently says 'Customer-managed key (KMS)' but users think it's a feature flag, not an ownership attribute.
Ben: Yep, seen that confusion in user interviews. They expect an explicit ownership marker like 'Managed by you' or 'Redwood-managed'.
Priya: Could we try a compact label that surfaces ownership first? e.g., 'Managed by you (KMS)'. Short and scannable.
Marco: That flips the noun order which might read weird in other places. What about 'Customer key (KMS) — you control access'? Might be long.
Ivy: We should avoid extra horizontal space. My vote: 'Customer key (KMS)' as the main label + small inline helper that says 'you control access'. Helper must be keyboard-focusable.
Ben: Accessibility note: the current helper icon isn't in tab order and has poor contrast. It needs role=button and visible focus outline.
Priya: Implementation idea: label text, then a button help icon with aria-label='KMS help' and aria-describedby referencing an offscreen paragraph with the full explanation.
Marco: Copy options for the explanation: short: 'Encrypts data with your KMS key. You control access and rotation.' long: 'Encrypts data using a customer-managed KMS key. You retain control over key access, rotation, and export.' Short is better inline.
Ivy: Agreed. Short copy for tooltip. For the audit log we need a more explicit entry when ownership changes. Right now audit says 'kms setting changed' which is too vague.
Ben: Suggested audit text: 'Encryption key ownership changed from Redwood-managed to Customer-managed (KMS) by {user}'. Also include prev/new key ids in metadata.
Priya: Backend note: we should add fields prev_key_owner, new_key_owner, prev_key_id (nullable), new_key_id (nullable) to the audit payload. UI will render friendly text.
audit-bot: Audit guidance: include human-readable and raw fields. Keep entries immutable and include actor, timestamp, and request id.
Marco: Layout nit: when retention=custom we show Region and KMS on separate rows and it looks disjointed. Can we align them horizontally on larger screens?
Ivy: Two-column compact form on desktop, stacked on mobile. Use CSS grid with two columns and gap 12px. Ensure tabbable order remains logical (retention -> region -> kms).
Ben: Also increase contrast of the 'Managed by you' badge to meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for small text).
Priya: I'll update the tooltip component to render as a <button> for keyboard focus, add aria-describedby, and wire the audit fields. Also add a link in the tooltip footer to /docs/security/kms.
Ivy: Final approvals? Design sign-off on label and tooltip copy, security sign-off on the audit phrasing and docs link.
Marco: Design: approve 'Customer key (KMS)' + tooltip 'Encrypts data with your KMS key. You control access and rotation.' Keep it single line.
Ben: Security: approve audit wording and request the log include prev/new key ids.
Priya: I'll open the PR with the grid layout, aria updates, tooltip copy, and audit payload changes. ETA tomorrow morning.
Ivy: Thanks team — small but important UX fixes. :rocket:
